findings.section: Requirement Coverage / Proposed Architecture and State Flow
findings.note: FR-003 unconditionally requires each status wait to end by its configured deadline, but this design only offers conditional return with a responsive supervisor and expressly disclaims return under supervisor/OS scheduling/termination failure. Keep such hosts unsupported, but resolve this requirement mismatch explicitly (for example via a human-approved operating-envelope clarification) before claiming FR-003 coverage; otherwise the proposed design cannot meet the approved MUST.
